Aplicações, experiência de uso, adoção,: Applications, user experience, adoption, infrastructure, professional development and support
O teste antes da compra e tudo o que ele: The test before buying and everything it requires: what the AI will do (2.1), who uses it and how (2.2), which tools and how they are paid for (2.3), internet and devices (2.4), professional development (2.5) and support (2.6). Each step corresponds to a layer of the total cost.
Primeira etapa da implantação, arquitetu: First deployment stage, architecture and integration
Depois do teste, a primeira etapa de uso: After the test, the first stage of real use: how many schools and people start, and how the tool connects to the education system's other systems.
Escala e horizonte, estimativa de custo: Scale and time horizon, cost estimate and recommendations
Até onde o uso pode chegar, quanto o cas: How far use can go, what the case costs over the years across the seven layers of total cost, and what to do next. The values are illustrative.
Que ferramentas você vai usar, como se p: Which tools you will use, how they are paid for, which licence they have, how much to adapt them and how large the test will be. These answers set the cost assumptions.
Internet e dispositivos são perguntas se: Internet and devices are separate questions: a school may have a good connection but lack devices, or the other way round.
Quem precisa aprender a usar a ferrament: Who needs to learn to use the tool, what kind of professional development, in which format, for how many hours and who pays.
Quem atende as dúvidas e os problemas da: Who answers schools' questions and handles their problems, and how closely the education system monitors use.
A implantação costuma começar por uma pa: Deployment usually starts with part of the education system. Say how many schools and how many people join the first stage, right after the test.
Arquitetura é a forma como a ferramenta: Architecture is how the tool works inside and connects to the education system's other systems. There are three common arrangements: a ready-made product the system subscribes to; an application, built in-house or contracted, that uses a company's AI model over the internet (API); or an open model installed in a cloud the system contracts. The arrangement changes the cost of integration, security and exiting the contract. If you do not know, the tool uses the architecture presumed from your answers in step 2.3.
As respostas sobre ferramentas, tecnolog: The answers on tools, technology, payment and licence feed layer 2 (AI applications, user experience and adoption); the level of adaptation feeds layer 4 (data integration and systems). Krueger and Jackson (2026, pp. 7–8) note that a free or donated tool does not remove lifecycle costs.
Camada 3 · Infraestrutura e dispositivos: Layer 3 · Infrastructure and devices. In the framework of Krueger and Jackson (2026, p. 11), AI increases demand on infrastructure and bandwidth as cloud use, device use and AI-enabled instructional services grow, and it accelerates existing pressures on device capability.
Camada 6 · Formação e capacidade das equ: Layer 6 · Professional development and workforce capacity. Krueger and Jackson (2026, p. 11) point to workforce readiness as one of the factors that weigh most on total cost and one of the largest barriers to sustaining AI: introductory training gives way to ongoing demands for coaching, governance training, technical support and role-specific training.
Camada 7 · Operação, suporte e sustentab: Layer 7 · Operations, support and sustainability. According to Krueger and Jackson (2026, p. 11), it requires ongoing technical support, monitoring, vendor management, maintenance, operational oversight, evaluation and sustainability planning throughout the lifecycle.
Camadas 4 e 5 · Integração de dados e si: Layers 4 and 5 · Data integration and systems; cybersecurity, privacy and compliance. In the framework of Krueger and Jackson (2026, p. 11), AI relies on interoperability, rostering, identity systems and student information systems, and it increases the importance of identity management, privacy protection and third-party risk management. The chosen architecture sets much of these costs.
Figura 1 de Krueger e Jackson (2026), em: Figure 1 of Krueger and Jackson (2026): the seven layers of the total cost of AI in education. 1 Governance, policy and lifecycle planning; 2 AI applications, user experience and adoption; 3 Infrastructure and devices; 4 Data integration and systems; 5 Cybersecurity, privacy and compliance; 6 Professional development and workforce capacity; 7 Operations, support and sustainability. Key takeaway: AI implementation creates ecosystem costs across seven interconnected layers, from governance and adoption to operations and long-term sustainability.
